svg.title: ReBuilt v2.0 — Welcome canvas, revision 2: brand logo + "Scan to start"
svg.desc: Navy 640x430 panel. The generated teal disc and recycling glyph are replaced by the ReBuilt logo at 96 px, sitting directly on the navy with no backing disc. Title, subtitle and the two buttons are unchanged except the primary label, which becomes "Scan to start".
